changes: Enable existing native finite-tap geometry and disconnect rules only in isolated ngspice technology; preserve distinct real body nodes.
Scale only existing area/perimeter devresist coefficients with native grid change; no sheet/linear coefficient change.
Use floating arithmetic in existing area/perimeter resistance computation; no fitted dimensions or values.
limitations: 132-device isolated fixture only:108 separate substrate branches and24 well branches, three actual sizes and all8 orientations. No assertion all108 bank contacts have yet been recovered.
5nm and10nm internal-grid extractions preserve physical geometry, exact dimensions and resistance. Disallowed finer-grid attempts are preserved separately, not passing grid coverage.
Existing frozen24-HBT fixture now has one finite substrate contact and all24 correctNx/CBE/body bindings; no PDK or old producer edit.
Strict native KLayout is the independent geometry/connectivity reference; all3 actual geometry faults rejected by both engines.
DC1V is a native foundry-subcircuit interface check only, not contact stress or distributed substrate characterization.
No full-bank transistor graph, distributed body resistance, coupled wireRC, fullRFPEX, process signoff or mainchip adoption claim.
Earlier missing-spinit and host-code-model initialization failures are preserved; final resistor-only interface supplies an explicit no-optional-model spinit and is warning/error-free.
